findings.evidence: Grep confirms matching sequences: Carrier has `definingIdeal` through both torus-conjugation theorems; Frobenius has the same ten declarations from `frobenius` through `map_subtype_fixedSubgroup_frobenius_eq`; RootDatum has the same four named pinning theorems. Only `F4/ShortRoot/AdmissibleLattice.lean:57` explicitly says it was adapted from E7.
findings.fix: Credit the corresponding `TauCeti.Algebra.Lie.E7.Minuscule.{Carrier,Frobenius,RootDatum}` files (and relevant originating PRs if known) in each adapted file.
findings.issue: `Carrier.lean`, `Frobenius.lean`, and `RootDatum.lean` closely reproduce the declaration order, interfaces, and proof structure of the corresponding `E7/Minuscule` files, but their References sections omit that formal source.

summary: Several files closely follow existing E7 carrier formalizations without crediting them; the isolated attribution in AdmissibleLattice does not cover these adaptations.
